Attached: 2 images

Upgraded my Jellyfin with Tvheadend and a cheap HDHomeRun tuner to bring live broadcast TV into the media server.

As someone who wrote his own TiVo (using PHP and a Hauppage card pm Linux) a quarter century ago, I feel like I FINALLY have a media and TV server that fulfills the promise of the television medium and technology.

#Jellyfin #Tvheadend #HDHomeRun #DVR #SelfHosted  #SchedulesDirect
